company.minerals.intro: Malin Koh Kong Peace Development Co., Ltd. is a private company doing business and providing services in the mineral resources sector. We focus on mineral exploration and on studying the potential of mineral areas, and we advise on, prepare and coordinate mining licence and permit applications for companies, investors and business partners who want to invest in mining in Cambodia.
company.minerals.summary: We explore for minerals and help companies and investors prepare, submit and follow up their mining licence applications.
company.sand.intro: Malin Koh Kong Peace Development Co., Ltd. is experienced in providing sand dredging, supply and transport services for all kinds of construction and infrastructure development projects.
company.sand.summary: We are experienced in professionally dredging and supplying sand for construction projects of every kind.

minerals.exploration.body: For mineral exploration projects, we can advise and coordinate from the preliminary study onwards: planning the project, preparing the exploration programme, the work plan and budget and the related technical documents, through to the reports and documents to be submitted to the competent authorities, according to the stage and the type of licence the client needs.
minerals.exploration.heading: Exploration projects
minerals.focus: As a professional services company, our main focus is helping clients clearly understand the conditions, requirements and procedures for mining licence applications, so that their application dossiers are accurate, complete, well organised and in line with the regulations in force.
minerals.goal.body: Our main goal is to be a partner clients can trust in preparing and running mining projects: reducing the complexity of administrative procedures, making application dossiers clearer, and helping clients carry out their projects in an orderly and efficient way, in line with the laws and regulations of the Kingdom of Cambodia.
minerals.goal.heading: Our goal
minerals.goal.vision: We aim to build Malin Koh Kong Peace Development Co., Ltd. into a reliable company with professional standards in mining licence consulting and coordination, focused on long-term relationships with clients, investment partners and the relevant institutions, and on supporting the effective, sustainable and responsible development of Cambodia’s mineral resources sector.
minerals.lead: Professional mineral exploration, mining licensing and regulatory coordination services.

minerals.licensing.heading: Licence applications
minerals.licensing.intro: We provide services at every stage of an application:
minerals.licensing.support: We also help clients prepare supplementary documents, explanations and responses to requests for further information, and coordinate on any document issues that arise while an application is being reviewed.
minerals.principles.body: Malin Koh Kong Peace Development Co., Ltd. holds to the principles of integrity, transparency, professionalism, client confidentiality and respect for the law in force. All our services are based on official procedures, correct documents and lawful coordination with the competent state institutions, not on guaranteeing results outside those procedures or on promises that go against state regulations.

privacy.cookies.body: This website doesn’t use cookies or similar technologies, and it doesn’t use analytics, advertising or tracking tools. It loads no content from other websites.

privacy.rights.body: You can ask us what information we hold about you, and ask us to correct or delete it. Contact us using the details on our contact page and we’ll reply within [period].
privacy.sharing.body: We share your information only with companies that help us run the website, such as our hosting provider, and only as far as they need it to do that. [Say where these providers store data, if outside Cambodia.] We may also share it if the law requires us to.

privacy.use.body: We use server records only to keep the website running and secure. We don’t use your information for advertising, and we don’t sell it.
process.delivery.text: At the depot, the team uses suitable machinery to prepare, stockpile and load the sand onto trucks, for delivery to customers and project sites as ordered.
process.delivery.title: Stockpiling and delivery
process.depot.text: Once the barge is loaded, the sand is carried and pumped on to the company’s storage and distribution depot.
process.depot.title: Transfer to the depot
process.dredging.text: We use a sand-dredging barge with a capacity of about 700 m³, run by machine operators and crew with the experience and skills for the job. On board, a team of about six is organised by task, with close attention to safety, coordination and efficient operation.

sand.commitment.goal: Malin Koh Kong Peace Development Co., Ltd. aims to be a partner customers can trust in the supply of construction materials, providing professional, responsible service that puts customers’ needs first.
sand.commitment.heading: Our commitment
sand.commitment.pledge: With our experience, workforce, equipment and operational capacity, we are committed to supporting the development of Cambodia’s construction sector, infrastructure and economy.
sand.focus: We focus on quality, efficiency, safety and timeliness, so that customers receive products and services they can rely on, matched to the real needs of each project.
sand.supply.chain: To keep supply fast and orderly, we manage the whole chain of operations: dredging, transport by water, transfer to the depot and stockpiling, through to delivery to customers.
sand.supply.heading: Fast, consistent supply
sand.supply.maintenance: We also keep our equipment, machinery and vehicles in good condition, to reduce interruptions to operations and keep supply consistent.
